details: NewChirp Android (newchirpmobile) over a USB-C adapter, profile 'Radtel RT-950' (owner's radio is an RT-950 Pro): Read radio shows SocketException Broken pipe errno 32 on 127.0.0.1. The Dart USB proxy (usb_radio_service.dart) wrote after the Python side (chirp_mobile.py) closed, so the underlying Python error is not shown. Also the wrong profile (RT-950 vs RT-950 Pro) may be selected.
summary: Android USB read: 'SocketException: Broken pipe' on the local proxy hides the real error
